violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed tuna salad at 50F, sliced tomato at 51F, washed lettuce at 51F, chicken salad at 50F in 6 DWR cooler (50F), that had been held in unit for 1 hr.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC move aforementioned food items to the freezer to rapidly chill to 41F or below in less than one hour. PIC understands all cold holding food items must be kept at 41F or below.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 6 DWR cooler at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC scheduled repair with technician during inspection. PIC will discontinued use of unite until the repair is completed.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed cooked green beans at 124F (2 hr) in 2 DR stacked warmer.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated green beans to 165F and placed them in a warmer holding at 135F or above.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed the warmer 2 DR stacked Alto-Shaam digital temperature reading at 185F; however , the unit is not properly maintaining the required hot holding temperature of 135F or above for food.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please ensure the warmer is repaired. Reston Hospital Center (Inspection Date: 05/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls are not maintained in good repair. Observed missing part of the wall behind 1 DR UPR Victory warmer.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC will email proof of the walls repair. PIC placed the request to engineering department.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at each handwashing sink.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: slicer and dicer at the back kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC properly cleaned and sanitized slicer and dicer.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed chicken wings at 104F -95F at hot well at service area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC discarded chicken wings.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed milk packages stored directly on the floor in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved milk packages to approved shelving units.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed knife stored between plastic containers and microwave at kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed knife , properly cleaned and sanitized it.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Spoons and forks were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. PiC placed all items with lip-contact surface facing down.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed burnt out light bulbs under the two hoods at the cook line. Observed a torn plastic cover inside the 1 DR UPR Beverage-Air refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC will email proof of the bulbs replacement and the plastic cover repair to EHS.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Observed cloth- towels in milk case.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC removed cloth-towels from milk case.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Weight and Thickness
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not sufficient in weight and thickness: Observed buns stored in non-approved NSF containers on the top of 2 DR UC cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated warewashing. EHS discussed with PIC that food items should be stored in approved NSF containers. PIC discarded buns.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): Observed milk crates being used to elevate food iteams in WIC and dry storage.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS discussed removal of all crates and replace with proper NSF storage containers as needed. PIC removed all milk crates and moved food items to the shelves. Reston Hospital Center (Inspection Date: 11/25/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. Observed an unapproved splitter attached to the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC disconnected the unapproved splitter from the mop sink faucet.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls are not maintained in good repair. Observed missing part of wall behind 1 DR UPR Victory warmer and a small hole in the wall above 2 DR UC cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC will email proof of the walls repair.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use next to the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. y EHS instructed PIC to clean out the mop heads, rinse them, and hang up the mops to air dry.
